meta.title: Generations — Build a Family Tree Together
meta.description: A collaborative family tree app. Build one shared tree with your relatives, then share a private link anyone can view — no account needed.

hero.headline: Your family's story,
hero.body: Generations is one shared family tree the whole family can build. Invite relatives near and far to add members, photos, and dates — and share a private link so everyone can explore it, no account needed, each in their own language.

features.sectionHeadline: Built for Families, Not Just Researchers
features.sectionBody: Everything you need to build one family tree together and share it with everyone who matters—wherever they are.

sharing.title: Share With Anyone
sharing.body: Send a private link to relatives anywhere—no account needed to view. Each person sees the tree in their own language: English, Spanish, or Russian.

collaboration.title: Build It Together
collaboration.body: Invite siblings, cousins, and elders as editors or viewers. Everyone contributes to the same family tree—no overwriting, no scattered spreadsheets.

privacy.title: Private by Default
privacy.body: Your tree stays private until you choose to share it. You decide exactly who can view or edit, and you can turn sharing off at any time.

faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.body: Everything you need to know about building and sharing your family tree.

items.q: Can I build a family tree together with relatives?
items.a: Yes. You can invite siblings, cousins, and elders by email as editors or viewers, so everyone contributes to the same shared family tree without overwriting each other's work.

items.q: Do people need an account to view my family tree?
items.a: No. You can share a private link, and relatives can view the tree without signing up. The shared view is read-only.
Generations is fully available in English, Spanish, and Russian. Guests viewing a shared link see the tree in the tree owner's language.
Yes. Every tree is private by default. Public sharing is off until you turn it on, and you control exactly who can view or edit, and can disable the link at any time.

cta.headline: Bring your whole family together.
cta.body: Start your family tree and invite relatives to build it with you—in minutes.

privacy.title: A calm, private place for family history
privacy.description: Generations is designed to help families document and share their history with clear expectations around access, visibility, and account control.
privacy.sectionOneBody: Trees are intended for invited access, giving families space to add names, dates, stories, and photos without publishing them broadly.
privacy.sectionTwoBody: When a tree owner collaborates or shares a public view, that access is a deliberate action they control and can revisit later.
privacy.sectionThreeBody: Language preferences, sign-in flows, and account settings are part of the product so users can manage access and keep their records up to date.

support.title: Support for using Generations
support.description: Generations offers a straightforward product experience for creating trees, inviting collaborators, and viewing shared family history.
support.sectionOneBody: New users can create an account, start a tree, and return to the dashboard to continue adding members and relationships at their own pace.
support.sectionTwoBody: Sign-in, language preference, password, and email-verification flows are available in-product so people can recover access and manage their accounts.
support.sectionThreeBody: Support is focused on helping users understand the current product experience; this page does not open tickets, provide live chat, or promise custom workflows.
